messages:
support_anna: Customer INC-9281 reporting sudden quality drop + billing surprise. They called region=eu and requested redwood-base-v1.4 but got short responses and emojis garbled. They claim billed at base rate. Link: https://support.redwood/example/INC-9281
support_anna: Customer supplied a repro curl: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-xxx" -H "X-Region: eu-west" -d '{"model":"redwood-base-v1.4","input":"Summarize: 🚀 Launch plan"}'
```
support_anna: They pasted response headers showing a different served variant and region: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-served-variant: redwood-lite-quant-v2
x-route-region: us-west-2
x-request-id: req_ea12bc34
```
support_anna: Body is truncated, emoji turned into unicode codepoints or dropped. Customer upset and asked for refund for last 2h.
sam_runtime: That header combo = cross-region fallback to a standby pool in us-west that only has lite quantized variants. Not surprising this changes tokenizer behavior.
sam_runtime: Why did eu route to us-west standby? Lina, any autoscaler or router policy flips overnight? :eyes:
lina_platform: No config flips. We saw a burst of auth-probe traffic from acct-348 at ~07:12 UTC which caused eu hostpool throttles and autoscale lag. Smart-router decided to fail over to standby in us-west to keep latency SLOs.
josh_sre: Confirming from infra logs: svc=auth-prober tenant=acct-348 rps~240 for ~90s at 2024-11-05T07:12Z. Fallback rule = prefer_region with fallback=standby. Standby pool lacks full variant set.
qa_miguel: Reproduced tokenizer gap: base-v1.4 tokenizer preserves emoji, lite-quant maps them to POSIX escapes or drops. Example: "🚀" -> "<U+1F680>" or omitted. I captured diffs.
sam_runtime: Also billing note: our billing pipeline charges by requested_model when served_variant is in fallback pool. So they were billed base rate even though they got lite outputs. We'll need to surface that mismatch.
billing_bot: billing config: current behavior charges requested_model unless served_variant marked as legacy_standby_override. That explains invoice.
support_anna: Customer wants immediate fix: rollback to base-v1.4 in eu or refund. They prefer correct model in-region.
lina_platform: Quick mitigations: (A) force tenant to eu-only routing (no cross-region fallback) (B) spin a hot base-v1.4 replica in eu (warm weights) (C) patch router to check variant compatibility before selecting standby.
sam_runtime: Short-term: disable cross-region fallback for acct-348 and warm a base replica in eu. Longer-term: add compatibility matrix to router (P0).
josh_sre: Repro steps for eng-runtime: 
1) ./tools/auth_probe.sh --tenant acct-348 --rps 240 --duration 90
2) curl sample with X-Region: eu-west model redwood-base-v1.4
3) check x-route-region and x-served-variant headers
Trace ids: req_ea12bc34, req_bf23de45 attached.
qa_miguel: I'll grab tokenizer vocab hashes from both variants for the ticket.
qa_miguel: Hashes: base-v1.4 tokenizer sha256: d4c3b2a1... ; lite-quant-v2 tokenizer sha256: 9f8e7d6c... different.
lina_platform: Patching tenant policy to block cross-region fallback now (policy id: policy-acct348-no-xregion). Rolling out.
deploy-bot: rollout policy policy-acct348-no-xregion started by lina_platform at 2024-11-05T07:46:30Z
lina_platform: Policy is live. Please validate with a quick customer test.
support_anna: Customer tested and now sees x-served-variant: redwood-base-v1.4 and emoji preserved. Latency up ~80ms but acceptable. Customer asked for postmortem.
sam_runtime: Action items: 
- eng-runtime: implement pre-routing compatibility check (variant compatibility matrix) P0
- billing: add alert for requested_model != served_variant billing cases P1
- infra/sre: improve autoscaler warmup to avoid cross-region fallback during auth probe floods P1
- support: issue refund/credit for acct-348 and update ticket (support_anna)
josh_sre: I'll aggregate traces from last 24h and open incident if repeats.
support_anna: Ticket updated and refund issued. Customer satisfied for now, asked for postmortem when ready.
sam_runtime: I'll own runtime RFC and timeline. QA to validate emoji/tokenizer vectors against matrix.
support_anna: Marking thread resolved-ish, keeping open for postmortem. Thanks all :heart:
